text:
maria (Product): quick heads-up — on small phones the side panel (asset inspector) gets pushed up by the keyboard and table columns collapse. repro: Console > Models > click row > tap edit prompt
sam (Design): saw that, repro on iPhone 8 and SE. It feels like two issues: breakpoints for when sidepanel should be side vs overlay, and keyboard interaction when an input is focused
lee (Frontend): interesting. current behavior uses position: fixed for the sidepanel and the table uses width: calc(100% - 360px). When keyboard shows, viewport height reduces but width unchanged so table gets weird wrap. possible fix: at <=360px convert panel to bottom-sheet (full-width) and make table become full-width too
sam (Design): bottom sheet seems reasonable. UX notes: bottom sheet should keep header with breadcrumb, have a visible grabber, and support keyboard-aware resize (avoid obscuring the active input). Also ensure escape/back gestures close it
joel (PM): impact? mobile sessions show ~0.9% hitting the inspector. Not huge but it's a bad first-time experience in demos. We should include in sprint if quick
maria (Product): prioritizing if fix is under 2 dev days. Also small copy tweak: change "Close" to "Done" when editing prompt to reduce ambiguity
lee (Frontend): prototype CSS I tried locally:
```css
@media (max-width: 360px) {
  .sidepanel { position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 72vh; border-radius: 12px 12px 0 0; }
  .console-table { width: 100%; }
}
``` 
This handles layout but we need to trap focus and update aria-modal
sam (Design): Accessibility: ensure focus is moved into panel on open, restore on close, announce "editor opened" with live region. Also increase hit target for close to 44px
lee (Frontend): noted. I'll add focus-trap and aria-live. One question: should bottom sheet be draggable to dismiss or only close button?
sam (Design): draggable is nice but harder. Start with close button + swipe-to-close later
maria (Product): @lee can you add a screenshot/gif in PR? will help reviewers
lee (Frontend): yep — will open draft PR by EOD
mobile-ci-bot: deploy preview available — https://preview.redwood.ai/pr/456 (checks passed)
joel (PM): thanks. If draft PR's small we'll slot it in next patch release
sam (Design): also quick copy: change "Inspector" label to "Editor" on mobile — less technical
maria (Product): agreed. small change. @sam please add to the design token doc
sam (Design): done — added to /docs/ux/mobile-tokens
maria (Product): resolved for now, moving to #inbox
lee (Frontend): starting work :hammer_and_wrench:
sam (Design): :thumbsup:
